Ui.Script:
local editModeFrames = { { name = "PlayerFrame", label = "Player" }, { name = "PetFrame", label = "Pet" }, { name = "TargetFrame", label = "Target" }, { name = "PartyMemberFrame1", label = "Party" }, { name = "PartyMemberFrame2", label = "Party" }, { name = "PartyMemberFrame3", label = "Party" }, { name = "PartyMemberFrame4", label = "Party" }, { name = "MinimapCluster", label = "Minimap" }, { name = "BuffFrame", label = "Buffs" }, { name = "TemporaryEnchantFrame", label = "Buffs" }, { name = "MainMenuBar", label = "Action Bars" }, { name = "MultiBarBottomLeft", label = "Action Bars" }, { name = "MultiBarBottomRight", label = "Action Bars" }, { name = "MultiBarRight", label = "Action Bars" }, { name = "MultiBarLeft", label = "Action Bars" }, { name = "ChatFrame1", label = "Chat" }, { name = "ChatFrame2", label = "Chat" }, { name = "ChatFrame3", label = "Chat" }, { name = "ChatFrame4", label = "Chat" }, { name = "ChatFrame5", label = "Chat" }, { name = "ChatFrame6", label = "Chat" }, { name = "ChatFrame7", label = "Chat" }, } local editModeActive = false
function BenillaEditModeText(label) return OptionsText and OptionsText(label) or label end
local function editModeHandle(entry, target) local name = "BenillaEditModeHandle" .. entry.name local handle = getglobal(name) if not handle then handle = CreateFrame("Button", name, target, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") handle:SetWidth(110) handle:SetHeight(20) handle:RegisterForDrag("LeftButton") handle:SetScript("OnDragStart", function(self) self:GetParent():StartMoving() end) handle:SetScript("OnDragStop", function(self) self:GetParent():StopMovingOrSizing() end) end handle:ClearAllPoints() handle:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", target, "TOPLEFT", 0, 0) handle:SetFrameLevel(target:GetFrameLevel() + 2) handle:SetText(BenillaEditModeText(entry.label)) handle:Show() end
function BenillaEditMode_Start() if editModeActive then return end editModeActive = true for _, entry in ipairs(editModeFrames) do local target = getglobal(entry.name) if target then target:SetMovable(true) editModeHandle(entry, target) end end ShowUIPanel(BenillaEditModeToolbar) end
function BenillaEditMode_End() if not editModeActive then return end editModeActive = false for _, entry in ipairs(editModeFrames) do local target = getglobal(entry.name) local handle = getglobal("BenillaEditModeHandle" .. entry.name) if handle then handle:Hide() end if target then target:StopMovingOrSizing() end end end
function BenillaEditMode_Initialize() for _, entry in ipairs(editModeFrames) do local target = getglobal(entry.name) if target then target:SetMovable(true) end end end
local function resetEditModeLayout() BenillaEditMode_End() for _, entry in ipairs(editModeFrames) do local target = getglobal(entry.name) if target and target:IsUserPlaced() then target:SetMovable(true) target:SetUserPlaced(false) end end ReloadUI() end
StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_RESET_LAYOUT"] = { text = BenillaEditModeText("Reset all moved interface frames to their original positions?"), button1 = BenillaEditModeText("Reset"), button2 = BenillaEditModeText("Cancel"), OnAccept = resetEditModeLayout, timeout = 0, whileDead = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, preferredIndex = 3, }

Scripts.OnLoad: BenillaEditMode_Initialize() BenillaEditModeToolbarTitle:SetText(BenillaEditModeText("Edit Mode")) BenillaEditModeToolbarHelp:SetText(BenillaEditModeText("Drag a handle to move a window.")) UIPanelWindows["BenillaEditModeToolbar"] = { area = "center", pushable = 0, whileDead = 1 }
